turns.speaker: AGT
turns.text: Namaste ji, main aapse yeh jaan'ne ke liye call kiya tha ki kya aap abhi free hain thoda discuss karne ke liye?

turns.speaker: CUS
turns.text: Haan ji, abhi free hoon lekin bas yeh bataiye kyun bulaya hai, kyunki main thoda nervous hoon kyunki humein abhi tak refund Power dikh raha hai lekin koi clear update nahi mil raha.

turns.speaker: AGT
turns.text: Ji bilkul samajh gaya, par pehle humein dekhna hoga ki aapke account number Reserve se koi issue toh nahi hai, warna yeh debit card Pro bhi affect ho sakta hai.

turns.speaker: CUS
turns.text: Arre yaar, main bas chah raha hoon ki koi solution ho, pehle bhi main NACH Click par attempt kiya tha par ab tak koi settlement clear nahi hua.

turns.speaker: AGT
turns.text: Theek hai ji, hum yeh sab dekh lenge lekin pehle aap ye bhi confirm kariye ke aapne kabhi tokenised card use kiya hai ya nahi, aur hum ZepLekha ya RuvVyaj ke through bhi check karwa sakte hain.
